s07.title: Add applicant
s07.enterHint: Type it in from Zillow, email or a paper form.
s07.hand: Hand the phone to the applicant
s07.handHint: They fill it in and sign. They can't see anything else.
s07.printHint: A PDF with this rental's questions.
s07.noSsn: Never collect Social Security numbers here. Screening services collect them directly.
s07.setPinFirst: This phone has no screen lock. Set an app PIN first so only you can end applicant mode.
s07.pdfFailed: Couldn't create the PDF. Try again.

s08.title: Application
s08.discardBody: Nothing you typed will be kept.

fields.occupants: How many people will live here, including you?
fields.petsNote: Don't list assistance animals — they are not pets.
fields.voucher: Will a housing voucher or rental assistance pay part of the rent?
fields.authorize: I authorize the landlord to contact my current and previous landlords and employers to verify this application, and to review a screening report I provide or authorize.
fields.certify: I certify the information is true and complete.
fields.attachPaper: Attach photos of the paper form
fields.receivedHint: Use the time you actually received it. Locked after saving.

questions.evicted: Have you been evicted or had an eviction case filed against you in the past 7 years?
questions.bankruptcy: Have you filed for bankruptcy in the past 7 years?
questions.smokes: Does anyone in the household smoke?

errors.contactRequired: Add a phone number or an email
errors.adultsExceedHousehold: More adults than people in the household
errors.moveInPast: Move-in date can't be in the past
errors.amountInvalid: Enter an amount of $0 or more
errors.fromRequired: Enter the month you moved in
errors.toRequired: Enter the month you moved out, or choose "I live here now"
errors.receivedInvalid: Enter a valid date and time

warnings.coverShortOfThreeYears: Add earlier addresses to cover 3 years
warnings.firstComeReceived: Use the time you actually received it.

s08a.title: Applicant mode
s08a.savedOnPhone: Your answers are saved only on this landlord's phone.
s08a.noSsn: Do not enter your Social Security number.

s08b.title: Application received
s08b.receivedOn: Your application was received on {{date}} at {{time}}.
s08b.a11yUnlock: Tap 3 times to hand back to the landlord

mode.unlockPrompt: Confirm it's you to end applicant mode
mode.exitBody: The applicant's draft will be kept.

s10.title: Documents
s10.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. You can still choose a photo or a PDF.
s10.deleteBody: It will be removed from this phone.
s10.proofHint: 2 recent pay stubs, offer letter, or benefits / voucher letter
s10.noStated: No stated amount for this income in the application.
s10.tip: Compare pay stubs with bank deposits; look for mismatched fonts or totals that don't add up.
s10.addFailed: Couldn't add the file. Try again.
s10.zoomHint: Pinch or double-tap to zoom (up to {{max}}×)
s10.openPdfHelp: Opens in the print preview. Nothing is copied out of Evenlease unless you print or save it.

pdf.title: Rental application
pdf.intro: Please print clearly. Every applicant 18 or older fills in their own application.
pdf.noSsn: Do not write your Social Security number or date of birth on this form. If a screening report is needed, the screening company collects that directly.
pdf.typeLine: Type: ☐ Rent ☐ Own ☐ With family ☐ Other
pdf.otherIncomeHead: Type (self-employment, benefits, child support, retirement, other)
pdf.landlordUse: For the landlord: received on ______________ at ________ (date and time)
